item.title: Fitness program
item.description: Warmup chin tuck wall: 2x10, 3s hold wall slides: 2x10 Half-kneeling hip flexor stretch, glutes squeezed: 2×30 s/side Short foot (lift arch without curling toes): 2×10, 5 s hold Dead bug: 2×8/side A goblet squat: 3x8 Chest-supported row: 3x10 (ring row) hip thrust: 3x10 (single-leg glute bridge, KB on hips) Single-arm landmine press: 38/side (Half-kneeling KB overhead press) Suitcase carry 3x30m/side Pallof press: 3x10/side (Ring fallout from knees, 3x6-8) B Romanian deadlift:3×8 (KB RDL, two-hand or single-leg) Pull-up / lat pulldown: 3×8 (Ring pull-up, or ring row if not yet) Bulgarian split squat (barefoot if possible): 3×8/side (Same, rear foot on bed, KB in hand) Turkish get-up: 3×2/side Face pull: 3×15 Ring face pull or ring Y-raise Push-ups: 3× near failure (Ring push-ups, push shoulder blades apart at top) Single-leg calf raise: 3×12/side Notes Pull : push = 2 : 1 Leave 1–2 reps in reserve All sets clean → add weight Only a light KB at home → 3 s lowering, 12–15 reps
